label.description: Volume label for the romfs image (not used by kernel but recorded in image)

alignment.description: Default alignment for regular files in bytes (must be power of two)

align_patterns.description: List of alignment patterns; each entry matches files and specifies alignment in bytes. Patterns may be absolute (starting with /) or relative (no slashes). Must be power of two alignment.

exclude_patterns.description: List of shell wildcard patterns to exclude from the image (e.g., 'CVS', '*~')

source_dir.description: Source directory to scan for files (defaults to current directory)

output_file.description: Output file or device for the romfs image (required)

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode; prints each file included and its offset
